cost_model.unit: one bounded-word operation, scalar transfer, cell load, cell store, cell allocation, branch decision, random byte or ideal-oracle call
cost_model.arrays: Each argument is cloned to an owned buffer: 3N cell operations. Whole-array assignment and return also cost 3N. Indexed writes modify that owned buffer. Fixed Array.init copies are charged by each cell; only the enumerated simple copy lambdas are accepted.
cost_model.coercions: W*.of_int and W*.to_uint are semantic word/integer coercions. Actual sign/zero extension and truncation are charged. All source arithmetic and actual call argument evaluation is charged, including signed comparisons and condition selection.
cost_model.ghosts: rt_work and rt_call_* bookkeeping are observational proof ghosts and are excluded from the measured algorithm.
cost_model.scope: Finite NTRU+768 RAM instruction bound, not CPU-cycle timing or a parameterized PPT theorem.
cost_model.procedure_boundary: A procedure simultaneous tuple-return binding is one boundary transfer; tuple construction, each source expression evaluation and each array payload 3N are charged separately. This is an abstract procedure-boundary accounting rule, not a count of native register moves.

manual_groups.name: WordChecks
manual_groups.mapping: RRecNormalize.run to RTFixedWordChecks.normalize; RRecTrit.check to RTFixedWordChecks.trit. rrec_center and is_trit are explicitly expanded into remainder, comparison, branch, subtraction and three equalities.
